newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends higher on short covering.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends higher on short covering.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled higher in light volume on short-covering ahead of Monday's USDA crop report, traders said.
"It was pretty much short-covering. There's some thought that the crop report will show an increase in spring wheat export sales," a MGE trader said.
Traders said May wheat outpaced new crop September on expectations that weekly state crop reports, also due out Monday, should show that planting has progressed at a rapid pace this week.
MGE spring wheat settled four to 5-1/4 cents per bushel higher, with May up five cents at $4.35.
July gained 4-1/2 cents to close at $4.33 and September added four cents to close at $4.31.
